title: Internal: how to reactivate a Club Membership contract from past-due standing
content:
## Scope
This document covers the tool that brings a Club Membership contract sitting in past due standing back to active standing.

## Situation of use and capability
This tool changes a membership contract's own lifecycle status from past due to active, and clears the contract's own recorded past-due-since date. It does not itself post any charge or payment.

## How it is invoked
This is an internal tool that must first be unlocked and then called: reactivate_membership_73e153df.

## Parameters
- membership_id: the reference number of the membership contract to reactivate, looked up from the member's membership holdings before the call.

## Return
A successful call returns a confirmation naming the membership contract and stating its lifecycle status is now active. If the membership contract does not exist on file, the same call reports that back in its return message rather than raising an error.

## Points of judgement
Calling reactivate_membership_73e153df on a membership contract that is already active still returns the same confirmation that its status is now active; the tool itself carries no record of whether the contract's own balance has been settled.
